dialogues.text_en: Whilst not as frigid as Garlemald, it is still quite cold here. Would that I had brought warmer garments...
Forename. Can you still use the path created by this “Ethos”?
Our circumstances are more complicated if not even you can return, so we should confirm this before aught else.
While 'tis heartening to know that you can return, I fear the two of us cannot so much as perceive the portal.
But we can worry about our passage home later. For now, let us endeavor to make the most of our presence here.
Whether we seek Calyx and Halmarut or the Winterer of this world, it begins with assessing our own situation. To that end, I propose we split up and explore the isle.
As I suspected, the wind crystals are not merely frozen over─they've been corrupted by ice.
Such a phenomenon is only possible through extreme and prolonged exposure.
The isle is smaller than I thought. There will be little game to be had...
By your expression, I take it you also found naught of note. Quite the quandary...
If we're to get anywhere, we must have some means of transport. If there were at least a large bird or the like...
What's this? Silhouettes in the distance, and they seem to be moving towards us. The answer to our prayers...or trouble?
Something makes its way to the isle, you say? Understood, I shall join you forthwith.
Five shadows... No, more. The numbers grow as we speak. I mislike the looks of this.
For a while I wasn't sure how we would fare, but it seems luck was on our side. Now we have an airship...albeit with a slew of caveats.
While I have a mountain of questions myself, looking after you all takes priority. You weren't hurt in the battle, I hope?
This world is far harsher than I had dared to imagine.
To have met someone like Visna was fortunate indeed. We must endeavor to familiarize ourselves with the customs of her world.
Doubly so if we are to meet her master. It wouldn't do to have a repeat of the earlier incident.
